answer: Two independent readers reaching the same answer: that is the whole check. Minutes are the toll no farm can dodge: 31 per proof, 7347 for 237, owed every epoch with no exception. One proof settles it, and it reads Wine gauger ruby port warrant racked in the fermenting room, spelled out in full as each ruby port is a season of logged pressing plus a signed vintner record. The paint log, read once, ends arguments that a hundred assurances cannot. When the trellis and the sonnet tell one story and the velvet tells another, believe the velvet: nurseries are harder to forge than names.
